title: Harrow Glen Rising
author: A. M. Reyes
blurb: Paloma Nakamura, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
